reviews.title: Must buy better then more expensive headphones
reviews.comment: Had some connection issues, use the phone app instead to update and later deleted it from my phone which fixed the problem. Sound is amazing and so is the battery life. For this price point I was not expecting it to be a top competitor since it is cheaper then most so a lot of value for money. Very light weight, comfortable, and functions at peak. Would recommend.

reviews.title: Awful connectivity
reviews.comment:
These headphones are a great price. The sound quality (when they work) is really good for the price. They are very lightweight and not uncomfortable.
Now for the bad; They don't work, or rather they stop working and need to be rebooted/connected or require a computer restart daily. I wear a headset a LOT, 3+ hours per day at a minimum. I have had these for 3-4 days and am returning them. I primarily used these headphones with my desktop PC using the 2.4 ghz wireless connection.
Just before writing this review I sat down and put these on my head and for the third day in a row they just don't work. I have to open volume mixer and make sure they are still connected, then turn the headphones off and unplug the dongle. Today I did all of that stuff and they still don't work. The volume knob is adjusted to max volume and the PC sound works fine out of the speakers if I swap to them. They are in wireless mode and the dongle shows a "green" connected light. On paper everything is working, but no sound. I worked for a decade in PC shops building custom PC's, helpdesk, virus removals, upgrades, etc. if you have to be more knowledgeable than me to get these things to work the problem isn't the consumer.
